selection_timing: After Phase IIb model results; before any actual human judgment. Retrospective purposive selection, not prospective model testing.
selection_criteria: Reuse archived cases; no new scored scientific items.
Cover enzyme assay, hydration thermodynamics, paired patient observations, longitudinal growth, and environmental measurement.
Keep complete narrow/stronger or correct/incorrect pairs with fixed source envelopes.
Include numeric contradiction, positive recorded fact, unsupported inference, and known evidence-type ambiguity.
Include unit conversion, experimental units, rounding/uncertainty, individual causal counterfactual, future-population generalization, and mechanism identification.
Select twelve cases to retain both the oxygen unit pair and mechanism pair and all six existing Phase IIb B response cases.
Do not select by predicted reviewer agreement or model success. All prior results were already known; no claim of model-outcome-blind selection.
reference_review_plan: Two appropriately assigned domain reviewers and one statistical/methods reviewer per case; partial assignments permitted and reported. Supplement formal/numerical expertise where needed.
candidate_review_plan: Separate package contains twelve existing raw B responses: six cases times two models, neutral candidate codes. Review only after locking independent reference judgments; no model identity in package.
